sources.title: BLS initial June 2024 payroll-employment estimate and revision notes
source_sections: Summary table B: June 2024(p), total nonfarm monthly change in thousands
Table B-1: seasonally adjusted May-to-June change
Technical Note, Reliability of the estimates: incomplete returns and preliminary status
Frequently Asked Questions, question 3: monthly and annual revisions
sources.transformation: Transcribed the initial total-nonfarm monthly change, publication date, measure, seasonal adjustment and preliminary status into JSON. Paraphrased the release notes on incomplete returns, the next two monthly revisions, recalculated seasonal factors and annual benchmarking. No later release values were substituted.
sources.acquisition_note: Verified against the archived official page through web retrieval. A direct Python download returned HTTP 403; the original HTML was not retained. No original-document hash is claimed.
limitations: Historical initial-release estimate, not the latest revised value.
Counts payroll jobs, not unique workers or household-survey employment.
Source snapshot contains a factual transcription and paraphrased revision notes, not the complete archived release.
